3. Influencer marketing with a global megaphone Olaplex has strategically partnered with over 400 creators, spanning everyone from TikTok trendsetters to celebrity hairstylists. passages.text: The Olaplex Oladupé Campaign: A Clever Marketing Stunt The Oladupé campaign by Olaplex was a clever marketing stunt that capitalized on the TikTok dupe trend, generating significant attention and engagement. The brand launched a fictitious product, Oladupé, presented as a dupe of Olaplex’s popular No. 3 Hair Perfector. This strategic move allowed Olaplex to tap into the conversations surrounding dupes on TikTok, while also showcasing the brand’s unique positioning and superior products. The campaign involved an innovative unboxing campaign, enticing influencers and professionals in the haircare community with Oladupé bottles.

passages.text: However, Olaplex’s paid social advertising efforts go beyond simply running ads. The brand also leverages the power of influencer marketing by collaborating with haircare professionals and influencers. By partnering with individuals who have a strong following and influence in the industry, Olaplex can showcase its products to a targeted audience that is likely to be interested in their offerings. One of the major benefits of investing in paid social advertising is the ability to amplify organic content and reach a larger audience. Olaplex utilizes user-generated content by actively participating in hashtags and commenting on relevant posts.

passages.text: Takeaways Olaplex’s rise to worldwide success can’t simply be chalked up to having great products (though that’s a huge part of it). They’ve managed to build a brand that feels personal, professional, and perfectly in sync with its audience. By balancing science-first messages with emotion-led storytelling, leaning into influencer partnerships, embracing internet culture with bold campaigns, and creating a seamless digital experience, Olaplex shows what modern beauty marketing looks like at its best. The key lessons? Educate your audience. Build trust through community. Stay culturally relevant. And above all, design every touchpoint—from TikTok to checkout—with purpose.
